comment: An array of navigation goals

fields.name: header
comment: This header will store the time at which the poses were computed (not to be confused with the stamps of the poses themselves)
In the case that individual poses do not have their frame_id set or their timetamp set they will use the default value here.

fields.name: goals
comment: An array of goals to for navigation to achieve.
The goals should be executed in the order of the array.
The header and stamp are intended to be used for computing the position of the goals.
They may vary to support cases of goals that are moving with respect to the robot.

This hold basic information about the characteristics of the OccupancyGrid

fields.name: map_load_time
comment: The time at which the map was loaded

fields.name: resolution
comment: The map resolution

fields.name: width
comment: Map width

fields.name: height
comment: Map height

fields.name: origin
comment: The origin of the map [m, m, rad].  This is the real-world pose of the
bottom left corner of cell (0,0) in the map.
This represents a 2-D grid map

fields.name: info
comment: MetaData for the map

fields.name: data
comment: The map data, in row-major order, starting with (0,0).
Cell (1, 0) will be listed second, representing the next cell in the x direction.
Cell (0, 1) will be at the index equal to info.width, followed by (1, 1).
The values inside are application dependent, but frequently,
0 represents unoccupied, 1 represents definitely occupied, and
-1 represents unknown.
This represents an estimate of a position and velocity in free space.
The pose in this message should be specified in the coordinate frame given by header.frame_id
The twist in this message should be specified in the coordinate frame given by the child_frame_id

fields.name: header
comment: Includes the frame id of the pose parent.

fields.name: child_frame_id
comment: Frame id the pose points to. The twist is in this coordinate frame.

fields.name: pose
comment: Estimated pose that is typically relative to a fixed world frame.

fields.name: twist
comment: Estimated linear and angular velocity relative to child_frame_id.
